prompt: I need to connect a list of FBIDs found in support tickets (the dim_tier1_job_final table) to a list of page IDs found in a target list. Unfortunately, our support tickets typically don't include a page ID. How can I connect these two lists of data in Daiquery?
response: To connect FBIDs from support tickets to page IDs in a target list, you can use a LEFT JOIN in your SQL query. This will allow you to match the FBIDs with their corresponding page IDs where available, and still include all support tickets even if there's no match. Use the FBIDs as the common field between the two tables.
